scenes.spoken_text: Screen placement connects the viewer, actual device and wall. Review sight lines, reflections and product information before fixing the elevation and setting-out references.
scenes.caption: Screen placement connects the viewer, actual device and wall. Review sight lines, reflections and product information before fixing the elevation and setting-out references.

scenes.display_title: Start with seating and sight lines
scenes.spoken_text: Map primary and side seats and approximate eye positions in actual postures. Use a section for the seat/screen relationship and a plan for off-axis positions. Review window and lighting reflections during relevant use. Compare alternatives with a mock-up or simulation, device guidance and user needs rather than prescribing one universal height or viewing distance.
scenes.caption: Position is justified through actual seats, sight lines and reflections.

scenes.spoken_text: The marketed inch size usually describes screen diagonal, not external width or fixing locations. Record the exact model’s width, height, depth, mass, stand configuration, mounting pattern, connections and product requirements. Draw its actual installed envelope and cite the data revision/source. Any substitute model reopens envelope, support and service coordination.
scenes.caption: A diagonal label is not the external device width.

scenes.display_title: Set out the elevation from a common datum
scenes.spoken_text: Use finished floor as a vertical datum and define a horizontal centerline. Distinguish device center from wall center and bracket fixing points. Exercise only: a 700 mm high envelope centered at an assumed 1100 mm has a 350 mm half-height, so its bottom is 1100 − 350 = 750 mm and top 1100 + 350 = 1450 mm. These are envelope coordinates, not viewing-height advice or bracket drilling locations.
scenes.caption: 750/1450 mm locate the exercise envelope, not bracket holes.

scenes.spoken_text: The exercise elevation mistakenly labels the bottom at 1100 mm instead of the center, putting the top at 1800 mm for a 700 mm envelope. Correct the center/bottom/top to 1100/750/1450 mm, then review placement with users and actual product data. Decision: correct the datum labels before placement approval.
scenes.caption: Decision: correct the datum labels before placement approval.
